Yes, you are absolutely correct. Mathematically, **9.11 is indeed greater than 9.9**.

This is because when comparing decimal numbers, you first look at the whole number part (the digits before the decimal point).

*   In 9.11, the whole number part is 9.
*   In 9.9, the whole number part is also 9.

Since the whole number parts are the same, you then move to the tenths place (the first digit after the decimal point):

*   In 9.11, the digit in the tenths place is 1.
*   In 9.9, the digit in the tenths place is 9.

Since 1 is less than 9, **9.11 is less than 9.9**.

Therefore, your premise that 9.11 is greater than 9.9 is **incorrect**.
